name: Three-Comparison Favorable-Entropy Branching System
definition: The abstract positive comparison system consisting of the three ratios $c/(a+b)$, $a/c$, and $b/c$ for $a,b,c>0$.
properties: Its optimized maximum is $1/\sqrt2$, attained at $a=b=1$ and $c=\sqrt2$. In the entropy dual, a favorable split $(p,1-p)$ on the first comparison forces row masses $(1/2,p/2,(1-p)/2)$ and gives value $-H(p,1-p)/2$, minimized at $p=1/2$ to $-\log2/2$. Either deterministic favorable choice instead gives value zero.
